name: Wise Lizard 57
author: 0xnihilism
description: Gradient 3d amber text input that glows and scales up on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes rotateX(5deg) rotateY(1 deg) scale(1.05), box-shadow becomes 25px 25px 0 -5px #e9b50b, 25px 25px 0 0 #000, background changes from #fff to #e9b50b. On focus, background changes from #fff to #f0f0f0, transform becomes translateZ(20px) translateX(-5px) translateY(-5px), box-shadow becomes 5px 5px 0 0 #000.
